{{Quote|You, Ori Garran! You sent your son to the scholars because he wasn't any good at the mill.|Adari Vaal to Ori Garran|<ref name="Skyborn" />}}
'''Ori Garran''' was an individual who sent their [[Ori Garran's son|son]] to learn from [[Scholar/Legends|scholars]] after his work at a mill proved dissatisfactory.<ref name="Skyborn" /> In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Skyborn]]'' to [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]].</ref> on the<ref name="Skyborn" /> [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="TEAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Kesh system/Legends|Kesh system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], the [[Geologist/Legends|geologist]] [[Adari Vaal]] spotted Garran in a crowd in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tahv]] while talking with [[Izri Dazh]]&mdash;a member of Kesh's ruling council, the [[Neshtovar]]&mdash;and reminded them why their descendant had become a student of hers.<ref name="Skyborn" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ori Garran was mentioned in [[John Jackson Miller]]'s [[2009]] [[eBook]], ''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Skyborn]]'', the second volume of Miller's ''[[Star Wars: Lost Tribe of the Sith]]'' series.<ref name="Skyborn" />
